# 1 Enoch Chapter 68 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**68:1** And-after-this my-grandfather-Enoch-gave-me-the-sum-of-the-teaching of-all-the-secrets in-the-book of-the-Parables which-had-been-given-to-him, and-he-put-them-together-for-me in-the-words-of-the-book-of-the-Parables.

**68:2** And-on-that-day Michael-answered-Raphael-and-said: The-power-of-the-spirit-transports-and-makes-me-to-tremble because-of-the-severity-of-the-judgment-of-the-secrets, the-judgment-of-the-angels: who-can-endure-the-severe-judgment-which-has-been-executed, and-before-which-they-melt-away?

**68:3** And-Michael-answered-again, and-said-to-Raphael: Who-is-he-whose-heart-is-not-softened-concerning-it, and-whose-reins-are-not-troubled-by-this-word-of-the-judgment [that] has-gone-forth upon-them-because-of-those-who-have-thus-led-them-out?

**68:4** And-it-came-to-pass-when-he-stood-before-the-Lord-of-Spirits, Michael-said-thus-to-Raphael: I-will-not-take-their-part-under-the-eye-of-the-Lord; for-the-Lord-of-Spirits-has-been-angry-with-them because-they-do-as-if-they-were-the-Lord.

**68:5** Therefore-all-that-is-hidden-shall-come-upon-them-for-ever-and-ever; for-neither-angel-nor-man-shall-have-his-portion-[assigned-to-him], but-alone-they-receive-their-judgment-for-ever-and-ever.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Hyphenated compounds preserve Ge'ez construct chains. Ch. 68 is the transition from the Noah interlude back to the angelic judgment tradition. It contains a remarkable exchange between Michael and Raphael (vv. 2-4) — two archangels reflecting on the severity of the judgment. Michael's refusal to intercede ('I will not take their part,' v. 4) is a strong statement. V. 4b — 'they do as if they were the Lord' — is the fundamental indictment of the fallen angels.*
